metadata.name: merces_protocol
metadata.description: Merces protocol: sealed-bid auction, treasury, ProofOfIncome verifier, split router, rate accumulator, payout vault, redemption/tail/pause/extinguishment and transfer window (SPEC §5–§7).

types.name: AllowlistEntry
docs: Allowlist entry (`[ALLOW, wallet]`). A missing account means "never allowlisted".

types.name: Auction
docs: Sealed-bid auction state (`[AUCTION, series]`).

fields.name: rejection_reason
docs: 0 = none, 1 = ClaimMismatch, 2 = InvalidClearingPrice (last rejected round).

types.name: Bid
docs: One bid per wallet per series (`[BID, series, bidder]`).

types.name: CurveProceedsCollected
docs: `collect_curve_proceeds`: the DBC migration fee and surplus withdrawn into the treasury
(`proceeds` = the treasury's new total), the partner trading fee into the fee collector.

types.name: CurveUnitsSynced
docs: `sync_curve_units` (and the snapshot inside a curve-mode `redeem`): `units_outstanding =
supply − protocol_held`, all in base lamports.

types.name: EscrowArm
docs: Armed `commit_ask` deposit for the unit mint (`[ESCROW_ARM, unit_mint]`, SPEC §4.1). Read by
the hook at bytes 8..40 (owner) and 40..48 (units).

types.name: FormalNoticeDue
docs: `trueup == false`: the report countdown of `period` reached the formal-notice threshold.
`trueup == true`: the true-up of calendar year `period` did (SPEC §6.4, `FormalNoticeDue(series, trueup)`).

types.name: FxCheckpoint
docs: Accumulator checkpoint at the first snapshot of a period (`[FX_CHECKPOINT, pair_id, period]`).

types.name: FxPair
docs: Rate accumulator (`[FX_PAIR, pair_id]`).

types.name: FxPairConfig
docs: FX pair configuration (`[FX, pair_id]`), `pair_id = keccak256(feed_id ‖ inverted_u8)`.

fields.name: crosscheck
docs: Cross-check feed: on Solana a second Pyth feed id (32 bytes stored as a `Pubkey`); zero when
none is configured.

fields.name: crosscheck_effective_period
docs: Period from which `crosscheck` applies (SPEC §3.1).

fields.name: prev_crosscheck
docs: The cross-check in force before `crosscheck_effective_period` (a change never alters the rule
of a running quarter).

types.name: Holder
docs: Holder record (`[HOLDER, series, wallet]`).

fields.name: undelivered_units
docs: Units minted to the auction escrow for this wallet and not yet delivered (accrual weight).

fields.name: ask_escrow_units
docs: Units escrowed in an open or unprocessed window ask (accrual weight).

fields.name: window_pending_units
docs: Units owed to the holder by processed window orders (fills bought, ask units returned) and
still in the window escrow until `deliver_order` (accrual weight).

fields.name: staked_units
docs: Curve mode: base lamports staked in the series stake vault — the holder's only accrual
weight (units outside the protocol move freely and earn nothing, CURVE_MODE §5).

types.name: Ledger
docs: Per-series repayment ledger (`[LEDGER, series]`). Zero-copy so account validation never puts it
on the stack. Optional values are `(value, has_*)` pairs; booleans are `u8`; field order avoids
padding (bytemuck `Pod`).

fields.name: window_acc_at_clear
docs: `net_acc_wad` snapshot at the active window's clearing (C-S4): once a window has cleared, a
matched ask's escrow earns through its holder weight only up to this point; the rest is
credited to the buyer of a sold unit and the seller of an unsold one at processing. 0 while
no cleared, unprocessed window exists (`window_cleared == 0`).

fields.name: carry_wad
docs: Exact WAD-scaled distribution remainder (`< units_outstanding`).

fields.name: units_outstanding
docs: `units_sold` at mint finalisation, reduced only by burns.

fields.name: unit_scale
docs: Accounting units per whole unit: 1 for sealed-bid series, `10^6` for curve-mode series
(base lamports, SPEC §9). 0 reads as 1.

fields.name: units_synced_at
docs: Curve mode: unix time of the last `sync_curve_units` (0 = never).

fields.name: staked_total
docs: Curve mode: Σ holder stakes (the earning weights; `≤ units_outstanding`).

fields.name: tendered_total
docs: Curve mode: units tendered against the redemption deposit (`≤ units_at_redemption`).

fields.name: year_pay_sum
docs: Σ `payment_usd` accepted per calendar year (tagged ring; bounds negative true-ups).

fields.name: curve
docs: 1 for a curve-mode series (SPEC §9).

fields.name: window_cleared
docs: 1 while the active window has cleared (a priced match) but not every order is processed
(C-S4); gates the ask-escrow earning cap in `settle_holder`. Never set for a `NoMatch`
window (no sold units, so the escrow earns in full until it is returned).

types.name: Order
docs: Window order, ONE per wallet per window (`[ORDER, series, period, owner]`).

fields.name: escrow
docs: Stablecoin for bids, units for asks.

fields.name: reveal_index
docs: Per-side reveal index.

fields.name: takeback_round
docs: Take-back tally round in which this order was counted.

fields.name: pending_units
docs: Owed to the owner after processing and paid by `deliver_order`: units (bid fill or ask
return) and stablecoin (bid refund or ask proceeds).

types.name: OrderDelivered
docs: `deliver_order` paid what a processed window order owes its owner (Solana addition mirroring
`BidDelivered`): `units` (bid fill or ask return) and `amount` of stablecoin (bid refund or ask
proceeds).

types.name: ParametersData
docs: Borsh-serialisable mirror of [`Parameters`].

types.name: PayoutDistributed
docs: `source`: 0 = Payment, 1 = Router, 2 = Tail, 3 = Final.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: `FeedId` but avoid the type alias because of compatibility issues with Anchor's `idl-build` feature.

fields.name: publish_time
docs: The timestamp of this price update in seconds

fields.name: prev_publish_time
docs: The timestamp of the previous price update. This field is intended to allow users to
identify the single unique price update for any moment in time:
for any time t, the unique update is the one such that prev_publish_time < t <= publish_time.
Note that there may not be such an update while we are migrating to the new message-sending logic,
as some price updates on pythnet may not be sent to other chains (because the message-sending
logic may not have triggered). We can solve this problem by making the message-sending mandatory
(which we can do once publishers have migrated over).
Additionally, this field may be equal to publish_time if the message is sent on a slot where
where the aggregation was unsuccesful. This problem will go away once all publishers have
migrated over to a recent version of pyth-agent.

types.name: PriceUpdateV2
docs: A price update account. This account is used by the Pyth Receiver program to store a verified price update from a Pyth price feed.
It contains:
- `write_authority`: The write authority for this account. This authority can close this account to reclaim rent or update the account to contain a different price update.
- `verification_level`: The [`VerificationLevel`] of this price update. This represents how many Wormhole guardian signatures have been verified for this price update.
- `price_message`: The actual price update.
- `posted_slot`: The slot at which this price update was posted.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration, one per deployment (`[CONFIG]`).

fields.name: domain
docs: `keccak256(1u8 ‖ chain_id_be ‖ registry_program_id)` (SPEC §1.3).

fields.name: early_draw_approver
docs: Zero when unset (early draws off).

fields.name: protocol_program
docs: The `merces_protocol` program id, fixed at init (no setter).

fields.name: protocol_authority
docs: `find_program_address([REGISTRY_AUTHORITY], protocol_program)`: the only key allowed to call
the write interface (SPEC §3.2 `registry_authority`).

fields.name: attestor_count
docs: Active key counts (a kind's last active key cannot be revoked, SPEC §1.4).

fields.name: curve_quote_mint
docs: The only quote mint curve-mode series may use (USDC of the cluster, SPEC §9), fixed at init
(no setter); zero disables curve mode.

types.name: Report
docs: Accepted report (`[REPORT, series, period]`).

types.name: Router
docs: Tier 1 split router (`[ROUTER, series]`); income lands in the `router_token` PDA.

fields.name: last_receipt_period
docs: Period of the latest receipt (0 = none yet).

fields.name: last_checkpoint_period
docs: Latest period with a recorded checkpoint (0 = none yet).

fields.name: init_period
docs: Period in which the router (and its receiving account) was created. No income can have
been received before it, so every earlier period's `ytd_at_end` is exactly 0.

fields.name: cp_period
docs: Ring of `ROUTER_RING` period checkpoints `{period, ytd_at_end}` (slot = period % ring).

types.name: Series
docs: One raise by one issuer (`[SERIES, series_id_le]`). The charter block is frozen once
`raise_state != Draft` (SPEC §3.3).

fields.name: stablecoin_program
docs: The stablecoin mint's owner program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

fields.name: unit_mint
docs: Set by `mark_raise_opened` (sealed bid) or `mark_curve_activated` (curve).

fields.name: router_theta
docs: Tier-1 plaintext terms (zero unless bit0 of `tier_flags` is set).

fields.name: dbc_creator
docs: `pool.creator` of the DBC pool at activation: the issuer wallet or the protocol's
`curve_authority` PDA (CURVE_MODE §6).

types.name: SettlementRejected
docs: `reason`: 1 = ClaimMismatch, 2 = InvalidClearingPrice.

fields.name: fx_fallback_sig
docs: Attestor signature over `MERCES_FX_V1` when the pair needs a fallback rate.

fields.name: attestation_sig
docs: Tier 2: report-verifier key; tier 3: attestor. None for tiers 1 and 4.

types.name: TrancheData
docs: Borsh-serialisable mirror of [`Tranche`].

types.name: Treasury
docs: Treasury bookkeeping (`[TREASURY, series]`); the stablecoin sits in the `treasury_token` PDA.

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Exact proceeds (`p* × units_sold`), written at finalize.

fields.name: extinguished_at
docs: `now` of the extinguishment (0 while not extinguished); caps vesting for the estate.

types.name: UnitsBurned
docs: `reason`: 0 = Retired, 1 = Redeemed, 2 = Extinguished.

types.name: UnitsStaked
docs: Units moved into the series stake vault (`staked` = the holder's stake afterwards).

types.name: UnitsUnstaked
docs: Units returned from the stake vault (`staked` = the holder's stake afterwards).

types.name: VerificationLevel
docs: Pyth price updates are bridged to all blockchains via Wormhole.
Using the price updates on another chain requires verifying the signatures of the Wormhole guardians.
The usual process is to check the signatures for two thirds of the total number of guardians, but this can be cumbersome on Solana because of the transaction size limits,
so we also allow for partial verification.
This enum represents how much a price update has been verified:
- If `Full`, we have verified the signatures for two thirds of the current guardians.
- If `Partial`, only `num_signatures` guardian signatures have been checked.
# Warning
Using partially verified price updates is dangerous, as it lowers the threshold of guardians that need to collude to produce a malicious price update.

types.name: Window
docs: Transfer window (`[WINDOW, series, period]`).

fields.name: rejection_reason
docs: 0 = none, 1 = NoMatchInvalid, 2 = PriceNotRevealed, 3 = NoCrossing (last rejected round).

fields.name: marginal_remaining
docs: Units left for the marginal bids at `p*` (branch A; first-come in reveal order).

fields.name: ask_at_total
docs: Class fill of the at-`p*` ask group before cancellations (A: `s_at`, B: `D − s_below`).

fields.name: ask_at_filled
docs: Units already given to at-`p*` asks (first-come against `ask_at_total − cancelled_units`).

fields.name: cancelled_units
docs: Fills of buyers cancelled at fill time (allowlist removed), taken back from the asks.

fields.name: next_bid_index
docs: Bids are processed in ascending per-side reveal index, then asks.

fields.name: tb_partial
docs: Units cut from the threshold order itself (`R − Σ_{key > k} q`).

types.name: WindowCleared
docs: `branch`: 0 = SupplyLimited, 1 = DemandLimited.

types.name: WindowSettlementProposed
docs: Window settlement proposal (Solana addition mirroring the auction's `SettlementProposed`;
SPEC §12: every state transition emits an event). `no_match = true` proposes `NO_MATCH`
(`clearing_price` is then `u64::MAX`).

types.name: WindowSettlementRejected
docs: `reason`: 1 = NoMatchInvalid, 2 = PriceNotRevealed, 3 = NoCrossing. `clearing_price` is
`u64::MAX` for a rejected `NO_MATCH` proposal.

types.name: WindowTakebackProposed
docs: Take-back threshold proposal (Solana addition, SPEC §7 cancelled-buyer take-back from the asks
below `p*`): the order with key `(price, reveal_index)` is proposed as the last one cut.

types.name: WindowTakebackRejected
docs: A take-back proposal that failed the tally check (never a revert).

types.name: WindowTakebackSettled
docs: The take-back threshold is settled: `below_units` units come off the asks below `p*`.
